description: AI-agent readiness audit of a website: score 0-100 and grade A-F across agent access (robots.txt rules for AI bots like GPTBot, ClaudeBot, ChatGPT-User; bot challenges), readable content (raw HTML without JavaScript, markdown), discovery (llms.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, Open Graph), agent interfaces (OpenAPI, MCP, A2A agent card, x402) and speed/HTTPS. Free preview by default (score, grade, category scores). With AGENTREADY_X402_PRIVATE_KEY set, returns the paid full audit (23 checks with evidence, robots.txt matrix for 17 AI bots, prioritized fixes, ready-to-paste llms.txt / robots.txt / JSON-LD / meta snippets) from https://api.youraitools.co/agentready/v1/audit, paying $0.03 USDC on Base per audit over x402. Automated checks of public URLs at the time of the audit; informational, no guarantee that a given AI product will crawl, cite or use the site.
